description: This Java source file defines the 'GenericServiceJob' class, which is part of the Apache OFBiz framework's service job package. It implements an asynchronous service execution job, handling service invocation, state management, result processing, and exception handling.

classes.name: GenericServiceJob
classes.description: A class representing an asynchronous service job within the OFBiz framework, capable of executing a service, managing its state, and handling success or failure scenarios.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the service associated with this job, manages its state, handles exceptions, and communicates results or failures to the requester.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Performs initialization steps before service execution, with verbose logging if enabled.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks the job as finished successfully and performs post-execution logging.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios, logs error details, and updates the job state to failed.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the context map for the service invocation.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to invoke.
